'''Szombathelyi Haladás''' ({{IPA|hu|ˈsombɒthɛji ˈhɒlɒdaːʃ|lang}}), is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Szombathely]]. ''Haladás'' is the [[Hungarian language|Hungarian]] word for ''progress''. The club, which was founded in 1919, plays its home games at the Haladás Sportkomplexum which has a capacity of 8,903. The club colours are green and white.

Haladás reached the [[Hungarian Cup]] final in the years 1975, 1993 and 2002. Since its first promotion in 1936 the club has spent 51 seasons in the first division of the Hungarian league, the [[Hungarian National Championship I|Nemzeti Bajnokság I (NB I)]]."}}
